title: UPSC EPFO Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner APFC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online for 80 Post
vacancyDetails: Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC): 80 posts; category-wise UR 29, OBC 18, EWS 8, SC 15 and ST 10.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in any stream from any recognized university in India.
ageLimit: Maximum age 35 years; minimum age is not specified. Age relaxation applies as per UPSC EPFO APFC Special Advt. No. 52/2026 rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS : ₹25/-; SC / ST / PH : ₹0/-; Pay the exam fee through online / offline fee mode only.
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Interview / Final Selection as per the official UPSC EPFO APFC recruitment process
documentsRequired: Photograph, signature, identity proof, educational certificates, category certificate if applicable and any other document required by UPSC
howToApply:
1. Visit the official UPSC online application portal
2. Register yourself and complete the One Time Registration (OTR), if not already done
3. Open the EPFO APFC 2026 application form
4. Fill the required details and upload documents
5. Pay the fee as applicable and submit the form
6. Save and print the final submitted application
shortDescription: UPSC EPFO APFC Recruitment 2026 online form for 80 posts under Special Advt. No. 52/2026. Apply from 22 August to 14 September 2026 at upsconline.nic.in.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has published the recruitment notice for Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) under Special Advertisement No. 52/2026 for 80 posts.

The online application window is open from 22/08/2026 to 14/09/2026 up to 06 PM. Candidates with a bachelor's degree from a recognized university can apply after checking the complete notification and completing UPSC OTR.

Important dates and fee

  • Application begins: 22/08/2026
  • Last date to apply and pay fee: 14/09/2026 up to 06 PM
  • Written examination: 20/12/2026
  • General / OBC / EWS fee: Rs. 25
  • SC / ST / PH fee: Nil

Vacancy details

Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC): 80 posts, including UR 29, OBC 18, EWS 8, SC 15 and ST 10.

Complete OTR, upload the required documents, verify the preview, pay the applicable fee and save the final application receipt. Read the official notification for selection procedure, syllabus, pay scale and age relaxation.
